thread:
maya (PM): quick sync — saw a spike in embedding errors after the recent batching opt. customers asking for fast fix vs longer-term tuning. who can triage today? cc @aj @tom

aj (Eng Lead): can you share the error traces? if it's a rollout regression we can hotpatch. if it's model drift we need evals. @tom can you pull traces?

tom (SRE): looking now. quickfind: 500s from embedding-service timeouts when batch_size > 8. repro in staging with cust-B corpus. logs: ```ERROR embed_service timeout batch_id=42 duration=95s```

rachel (Design): customer also asked for better recall on search — adding negatives/curation is an enhancement, not a quick fix.

lee (Customer Success): fyi customer-A is on Dedicated and flagged SLA hits. they want ETA for a fix.

maya (PM): high-level options: 1) hotpatch revert batching change (2h + canary) 2) short mitigation: cap default batch_size for impacted tenants (1h deploy/region) 3) enhancement: tuning + evals (multi-day). prioritize by SLA + impact. thoughts?

aj (Eng Lead): if timeouts only occur when batch > 8 we can force-cap at 8 per-tenant immediately via a feature flag. I can PR ~1h.

tom (SRE): agree. also enable per-tenant rate limiting so a noisy tenant doesn't blow up inference pools. I can wire flag into infra once PR ready. need a deploy window.

lee (Customer Success): :thumbsup: customer-A accepts temporary cap as mitigation. please confirm ETA so I can tell them.

maya (PM): plan: aj implements batch-cap flag for affected tenants, roll to Dedicated regions by EOD, monitor. create a backlog ticket for tuning embeddings/recall. rachel to draft customer comms. rollback plan if regressions.

rachel (Design): drafting a short message for the customer thread and will propose UI copy for tenant-level override.

tom (SRE): deploy-bot: canary schedule?

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled by @aj at 1769990200. Monitor channel: #incidents-embeddings

aj (Eng Lead): PR: https://github.com/redwood/embed-service/pull/432 -> CI green locally. requesting review from @tom

tom (SRE): quick QA: repro in staging with batch=16 -> 95s, batch=8 -> 22s. cap looks safe.

maya (PM): good. after rollout we'll triage backlog: either keep cap and treat tuning as a roadmap epic, or revert after a model/infra fix. scheduling "Embeddings robustness" in next planning meeting and adding ticket RDW-321.

lee (Customer Success): customer wants a follow-up demo once stabilized — please tag me when deployed.

aj (Eng Lead): merged. rolling canary now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by @aj at 1769990200. Canary in us-west-2.

tom (SRE): canary healthy after 10m. p50/p95 latency stable. no errors for tenant-A sample.

maya (PM): :tada: thanks team. notes: temporary cap hotpatch + backlog ticket RDW-321 for embedding tuning. owners: aj (hotpatch), rachel (comm), tom (monitor), maya (PM).

lee (Customer Success): customer confirmed SLA restored. thanks all.

aj (Eng Lead): next steps: spec smaller quantization/kv-cache experiments to reduce latency. I'll add details to RDW-321.

maya (PM): filing follow-on milestone: "Embeddings robustness" -> link to RDW-321 in sprint board. we'll review impact vs cost in next grooming.

(rough times: root 1769990003, canary start 1769990200, follow-ups through 1769990240)
